headline: TEX @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 3.94 at STL 3.06, with a projected total of 7.00. Movement read: Both offenses moved down (TEX -0.20, STL -0.30), so the movement points more toward run suppression than a clearer side. The projected total fell -0.50, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -21.0%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Nathan Eovaldi has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Josh Jung, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nolan Gorman, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
